item.subject: science
item.stem:
Ojas stirs sugar into water until the sugar dissolves. He can still taste the sugar, and the water still feels wet. Separately, he mixes iron filings and sulphur powder that stay visible as two materials.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.A: Sugar-water is a mixture because sugar and water are physically mixed and each keeps its own properties.
options.B: Iron filings with sulphur powder is a mixture because two substances are physically mixed and each keeps its own properties.
options.C: Sugar-water is not a mixture because the sugar can no longer be seen separately.
options.D: Iron filings with sulphur powder is not a mixture because both materials are solids.
